cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(CDesign LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

# Chinese output on Chinese Windows: source is UTF-8, console is GBK(936).
if(MINGW)
    add_compile_options(-fexec-charset=GBK)
endif()

# ============================================================
# Every .cpp in src/ becomes its own program with the same name.
#
# DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE.
# DO NOT use the "Add to target" checkbox in CLion -- it appends
# other .cpp files into add_executable() and breaks the build
# (multiple definition of 'main').
# The block below auto-repairs that damage.
# ============================================================
file(GLOB SOURCES "src/*.cpp")
foreach(src ${SOURCES})
    get_filename_component(name ${src} NAME_WLE)
    string(REPLACE "." "_" tgt "${name}")

    add_executable(${tgt} ${src}
            src/lab1.3.cpp
            src/lab1.4.cpp
            src/lab2.1.cpp
            src/lab2.2.cpp)
    set_target_properties(${tgt} PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME "${name}")

    get_target_property(_cur ${tgt} SOURCES)
    list(LENGTH _cur _n)
    if(_n GREATER 1)
        set_property(TARGET ${tgt} PROPERTY SOURCES "${src}")
        message(STATUS "auto-fixed sources of target '${tgt}'")
    endif()
endforeach()
